blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Conventional image registration algorithms are robust to domain shifts and achieve low errors, but they are slow and computationally expensive. Deep-learning methods are efficient at inference-time, but face challenges in out-of-domain samples. We propose Recursive Uncertainty-Gated Image Registration (RUGI), an algorithm for iteratively refining deformation fields predicted by learning-based registration models. At each iteration, the registration model predicts an incremental deformation, and a gating map modulates the update. Refinements are hence concentrated in regions that remain difficult to register. We explore two gating strategies: a learned uncertainty-based approach and an image residual error approach. We evaluate RUGI on cardiac MRI and echocardiography datasets and show consistent improvements over single-step inference. Ablation experiments demonstrate that iterative refinement alone improves registration, but informative spatial gating provides a significant additional benefit. The error-gated variant of RUGI can also be applied directly to existing pretrained models; applied to VoxelMorph, TransMorph, and CycleMorph, it yields MSE reductions of 27–37% with no modification to the original training procedure. The improvements in registration performance are reflected in decreased errors in ejection fraction estimation relative to ground truths. These results demonstrate that spatially selective iterative refinement provides an effective strategy to improve registration accuracy at inference-time.
blocks.zh: 常规图像注册算法对于域位移并实现低误差是稳健的,但速度缓慢,计算成本昂贵. 深层学习方法在推论时间是有效的,但在域外样本中面临挑战. 我们提出递归不确定的图像注册(RUGI),这是一种通过基于学习的注册模型预测的迭代提炼变形场的算法. 在每次迭代时,登记模型都会预测增量变形,并有吉祥图对更新进行调制. 因此,改进工作集中在仍然难以登记的地区。 我们探索了两种定位策略:一种基于不确定性的学习方法,另一种是图像残余误差方法. 我们评价RUGI的心脏核磁共振和回声心电图数据集,并显示与单步推论相比的一致改进. 配位实验表明,单是迭代改进就可以改善登记,但信息化的空间配位法提供了重要的额外好处。 RUGI的误差变体也可以直接应用到现有的预训模型上;它应用于VoxelMorph,TransMorph,以及CycleMorph,它的MSE减产率为27-37%,而原来的训练程序没有修改. 与地面真相相比,喷射分数估计误差减少,反映出登记业绩的改善。 这些结果表明,空间选择性迭代改进为提高推断时的登记准确性提供了一个有效的战略。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Image registration is a fundamental task in medical image analysis, with applications in diagnostics, treatment planning, and image-guided intervention. In magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), image registration is used to align scans acquired at different time points, contrasts, or respiratory states, enabling longitudinal analysis and multimodal fusion. In ultrasound (US), image registration is used to compensate for tissue motion during freehand acquisitions to improve temporal consistency, and enable downstream analyses such as strain estimation, image compounding, and vascular imaging.
blocks.zh: 图像注册是医疗图像分析中的一项基本任务,在诊断,治疗规划和图像引导干预中都有应用. 在磁共振成像(MRI)中,图像注册用于对不同时点、对比度或呼吸状态下获得的扫描进行对齐,从而能够进行纵向分析和多模式聚变。 在超声波(美国)中,图像登记用于补偿自由手获取过程中的组织运动,以提高时间一致性,并能够进行下游分析,如菌株估计、图像复合和血管成像。

blocks.en: In recent years, learning-based image registration methods have gained substantial attention due to their speed at inference and their performance. Typically, a neural network receives a fixed and moving image pair and estimates a dense displacement field that can be used to warp one image to match the other. Learning-based approaches enable fast inference at test time and can learn complex, data-driven regularisation priors, and are able to generalize across image pairs and, in some cases, across datasets without a need for further training [ 1 , 2 ] .
blocks.zh: 近年来,基于学习的图像注册方法因其推论速度和性能而获得极大关注. 通常,神经网络接收固定的和移动的图像对,并估计一个密集的移位场,可以用来将一个图像曲折到另一个图像. 以学习为基础的方法能够在测试时快速推论,能够学习复杂、数据驱动的规范化前科,并且能够将图像对和在某些情况下跨数据集概括,而无需进一步培训[1,2]。

blocks.en: The estimation of spatial correspondence between images is inherently ill-posed: a given pair of images rarely constrains a single unique correspondence field, and the estimated transformation can be highly sensitive to small changes in image content or quality. The degree of ill-posedness is spatially varying across the image pair. Regions with high image quality, clear structure and small, simple motion will tend to be well-constrained, yielding deformations that are unique and stable. Other image regions, with low image quality or complex deformations will constrain correspondences badly, meaning more potential solutions exist. This means the difficulty of the registration task varies across the field of view, and no single fixed strategy is optimal everywhere. This sensitivity to data characteristics limits the ability of fixed, trained models to generalize reliably to new domains, motivating inference-time strategies that can adapt to the specific properties of each image pair.
blocks.zh: 对图像间空间通信的估测是内在的不正确:给定的一对图像很少会约束一个单一的独特通信领域,估计的转换可以对图像内容或质量的小变化高度敏感. 错位程度在空间上在图像对之间有差异. 图像质量高,结构清晰,运动小而简单的区域,往往会受到很好的约束,产生独特而稳定的变形. 其他图像区域,图像质量低或变形复杂,会严重制约函证,意味着存在更多的潜在解决方案. 这意味着登记任务的难度在不同的视野中不尽相同,没有单一的固定策略是各地最佳的. 这种对数据特性的敏感性限制了固定的,训练有素的模型可靠地概括到新域的能力,激发了能够适应每个图像配对的特定属性的推论时间策略.

blocks.en: While conventional registration algorithms perform well and are dataset-agnostic, they are computationally expensive. In contrast, deep-learning methods are quick but are not able to adapt to out-of-domain or challenging samples. We propose an iterative strategy which improves performance of deep-learning models. Our contributions are: 1. We introduce a registration refinement framework where iterative updates are gated, concentrating refinement in regions that need it. 2. We evaluate two gating strategies, based on predictive uncertainty and residual image error, and show both improve registration accuracy above single-step inference. 3. Through an ablation study, we separate the contribution of iterative refinement and spatial gating. 4. We show the method can be applied to pretrained models with no need for retraining by using an image similarity-based sampling function. 5. We validate RUGI for uncertainty estimation and cardiac functional parameter estimation.
blocks.zh: 虽然传统的登记算法表现良好,而且具有数据集不可知性,但计算费用昂贵。 相反,深入学习的方法很快,但无法适应域外或具有挑战性的样本。 我们建议采取迭代战略,改进深入学习模式的绩效。 我们的贡献是: 1. 我们引入了一个登记完善框架,将迭代更新作为大门,将完善工作集中在需要更新的区域。 2. 我们根据预测性不确定性和剩余图像误差,评估两个测量战略,并显示这两个战略在单步推论之上提高了登记准确性。 3. 通过一项消化研究,我们把迭代完善和空间定位的贡献分开。 4. 我们通过使用基于图像相似性的取样功能,表明该方法可以适用于不需要再培训的预先训练的模型。 5. 我们验证RUGI的不确定性估计和心脏功能参数估计。

blocks.zh: 我们引入了一个登记完善框架,将迭代更新作为大门,将完善工作集中在需要更新的区域。

blocks.en: We evaluate two gating strategies, based on predictive uncertainty and residual image error, and show both improve registration accuracy above single-step inference.

blocks.zh: 通过一项消化研究,我们把迭代完善的贡献和空间定位区分开来.

blocks.en: 2 Background
blocks.zh: 2 背景情况

blocks.en: Iterative and cascaded registration strategies emerged as a way to handle large or complex deformations by decomposing the registration task into a sequence of simpler predictions. LapIRN estimates the deformation in a coarse-to-fine manner using a Laplacian pyramid, where the network at each pyramid level predicts residual deformation fields that are composed with coarser predictions to recover large diffeomorphic deformations [ 3 ] . Cascaded VoxelMorph-based approaches similarly improve alignment through a sequence of refinement stages, in which each network receives the partially aligned images from the previous stage and predicts an updated deformation field [ 4 ] . Related ideas have also appeared in recursive and recurrent registration networks, where repeated prediction-and-warping steps progressively expand the transformations that can be estimated by the model and improve registration accuracy [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] . These methods apply refinements uniformly across the full image domain, regardless of the spatial heterogeneity or the confidence in the predictions. Moreover, as they introduce changes to model architecture, any further optimisation requires retraining.
blocks.zh: 迭代式和级联式的登记战略成为处理大型或复杂变形的一种方式,将登记任务分解成一系列较简单的预测。 LapIRN使用拉普拉西亚金字塔以粗对细的方式估算变形,其中每个金字塔水平的网络预测残余变形场,这些变形场由变形器预测组成,以恢复大型的异形变形[3]. 连锁酒 以摩尔法为基础的方法通过一系列完善阶段同样改进了对齐,其中每个网络接收上一个阶段的部分对齐的图像并预测更新的变形场[4]. 相关的想法也出现在递归式和经常性的登记网络中,在这些网络中,反复的预测和减震步骤逐渐扩大模型可以估计的转换,并提高登记准确性[5,6,7]. 这些方法统一适用于整个图像领域,无论空间异质性或对预测的信心如何。 此外,在对示范结构进行修改时,任何进一步的优化都需要再培训。

blocks.en: A related line of work for inference-time refinement is test time optimisation (TTO), where the model itself or its outputs are adapted given the test data. [ 8 ] constructed a network to model the residual deformations and fine-tune the registration model on each test pair. [ 9 ] formulated registration as a meta-learning task, training networks to maximise efficiency of test-time optimisation. [ 10 ] proposed a novel architecture which uses iterative multi-scale inference using residual flow estimators. While these methods improve accuracy at inference, they apply refinement within the network architecture, so their application to new out of domain data would require model redesign, specialized training and reoptimisation. As before, refinement is applied across the images without selectivity.
blocks.zh: 改进推断时间的一个相关工作是测试时间优化(TTO),根据测试数据调整模型本身或其产出。 [8]构建一个网络,以模拟残余的变形,并微调每个测试对上的注册模型. [9] 将登记作为一项元学习任务,培训网络,以最大限度地提高测试时间优化的效率。 [10] 提出了一种新颖的架构,采用利用剩余流估计器的迭代多尺度推论. 虽然这些方法在推论上提高了准确性,但它们在网络架构内进行了改进,因此,将其应用于新的域外数据需要重新设计模型、专门培训和重新优化。 同以往一样,在图像中不加选择地加以改进。

blocks.en: Several works have explored how uncertainty can be incorporated into the registration process itself. Uncertainty-guided approaches have been proposed to weight regularization terms or consistency constraints according to the estimated epistemic uncertainty of the model, thereby allowing uncertain regions to contribute differently during training or optimization [ 11 ] . More recently, Tian et al. proposed a model-agnostic, inference-time uncertainty estimation framework for pretrained registration networks based on transformation equivariance [ 12 ] . Their method perturbs the input images with known transformations and evaluates the consistency of the predicted deformation under these perturbations. They showed strong correlation between the estimated uncertainty and registration error across multiple anatomical structures and pretrained models.
blocks.zh: 一些工作探讨了如何将不确定性纳入登记过程本身。 根据模型的估计概论性不确定性,提出了不确定的指导性方法,以衡量规范化术语或一致性制约因素,从而使不确定的区域在培训或优化过程中作出不同的贡献[11]。 最近,Tian等人提出了基于变异性的预先培训登记网络模型-不可知性、推论时间不确定性估计框架[12]。 他们的方法用已知的变换来扰动输入图像,评价在这些扰动下预测变形的一致性. 它们表明,估计的不确定性与多个解剖结构和预先训练模型的登记错误之间有很强的关联。

blocks.en: Although these methods provide important contributions, most require changes to the model structure or training procedure to estimate uncertainty [ 13 , 14 ] . The approaches that use the uncertainty to improve registration do so in limited ways, by changing the regularisation spatiotemporally [ 11 ] or by weighting the contribution of different regions to the loss [ 15 ] . [ 12 ] proposed a model-agnostic, inference-time uncertainty estimation framework, but they did not apply the uncertainty estimation to improve the registration itself. To our knowledge, no existing methods leverage the inference-time uncertainty estimation to iteratively refine the deformation field in selective regions. This gap motivates the development of a method that can quantify epistemic uncertainty and use it to guide the focused refinement of registration at inference time, without requiring model retraining.
blocks.zh: 虽然这些方法做出了重要贡献,但大多数方法要求改变模型结构或培训程序,以估计不确定性[13、14]。 利用不确定性改进登记的方法是有限的,方法是迅速改变规范化[11]或加权不同区域对损失的贡献[15]。 [12]提出了模型-不可知、推断的不确定性估计框架,但没有应用不确定性估计来改进登记本身。 据我们所知,没有任何现有方法利用推论时间的不确定性估计来反复完善选定区域的变形场。 这一差距促使人们制定一种方法,可以量化感知不确定性,并用它来指导在推断时间对登记进行有重点的改进,而不需要模式再培训。

blocks.en: Iterative refinement is applied until a similarity-based stopping criterion is satisfied. The similarity metric can be tuned to the specific dataset, or additional stopping criteria can be applied to constrain the deformations. We investigated multiple similarity metrics and empirically chose the MSE, as it was robust and consistently led to reliable results. We added a second stopping criterion as a safeguard against severe folding. After a two-iteration warmup, the Jacobian determinant of the composed candidate field was calculated within the inner region of the field of view. If the 1st percentile of the Jacobian distribution was below -0.4, the candidate update was rejected and iterative refinement was terminated. The calculation of the Jacobian excluded a 5-pixel border around the images. This criterion was used to prevent severe folding rather than to impose strict diffeomorphism.

blocks.en: 3.1.1 Uncertainty-based gating
blocks.zh: 3.1.1 基于不确定性的标注

blocks.en: Uncertainty can be used to guide the selective gating process. In this case, regions with low predicted uncertainty receive smaller updates and stabilize earlier in the iterative refinement, while high-uncertainty regions continue to receive updates.

blocks.en: 3.1.2 Error-based gating
blocks.zh: 3.1.2 基于错误的标注

blocks.en: Uncertainty estimates are often evaluated using their correspondence with prediction error [ 12 , 16 ] , with high-uncertainty regions being expected to exhibit larger registration errors. Motivated by this relationship, we also consider an error-based weighting strategy, which provides a simpler and cheaper alternative to the uncertainty-based method.
blocks.zh: 不确定估计往往用它们与预测错误[12,16]的对应关系来评价,预计高度不确定的区域会出现较大的登记错误。 在这种关系的推动下,我们也考虑一种基于错误的加权策略,它为基于不确定性的方法提供了更简单,更便宜的替代方法.

blocks.en: In this case, a per-pixel error measure between the fixed image I f ​ i ​ x ​ ( x ) I_{fix}(x) and the current warped image I ( t − 1 ) I^{(t-1)} is calculated, smoothed and normalized to produce the gating map s ( t ) s^{(t)} . Regions with larger mismatch are assigned larger updates and continue to be refined, while regions with smaller residual error are assigned smaller updates.

blocks.en: This error-based gating method uses only the registration model R R and does not require retraining when changing datasets. It is computationally inexpensive and easily adaptable, as the residual measure can be replaced to fit new modalities or settings.
blocks.zh: 这种基于错误的配位法只使用注册模式R R,在改变数据集时不需要再培训. 它在计算上成本低廉,易于适应,因为剩余措施可以被替换以适应新的模式或环境。

blocks.en: A post hoc measure of the uncertainty can be calculated using the standard deviation of the incremental deformation estimates across iterations. However, this quantity should not be interpreted as a calibrated uncertainty estimate; rather, it provides a measure of spatial heterogeneity in the refinement process.
blocks.zh: 不确定性的事后计量可以使用跨迭代增量变形估计的标准偏差计算. 然而,这一数量不应被解释为一种经过校准的不确定性估计;相反,它提供了完善过程中空间异质性的尺度.

blocks.en: 3.3 Implementation details
blocks.zh: 3.3 详细执行情况

blocks.en: We used a compact Bayesian U-Net-inspired architecture containing two downsampling stages and eight convolutional layers, with approximately 1.9M trainable parameters. All input images were resized to 128x128 pixels. This architecture was selected because the predicted deformation fields were expected to vary smoothly over spatial scales, reducing the need for deep networks. This architecture was found to obtain accurate registration across the evaluated ultrasound and MRI datasets. The BNN provides a distribution over predicted deformation fields, which is useful for estimating spatial uncertainty. At inference, the stochasticity is turned off. The Bayesian layers were parameterised using prior standard deviations σ 1 = 1.0 \sigma_{1}=1.0 and σ 2 = 0.002 \sigma_{2}=0.002 , mixture coefficient π = 0.5 \pi=0.5 , posterior mean μ = 0 \mu=0 , and posterior parameter ρ = − 3.0 \rho=-3.0 .
blocks.zh: 我们使用了一个紧凑的巴耶西亚U-Net启发式建筑,包含两个下取样阶段和八个演化层,有大约1.9M的可训练参数. 所有输入图像被调整为128x128像素. 这种架构之所以被选中,是因为预计的变形场在空间尺度上会平稳变化,从而减少了对深层网络的需求. 这一架构被发现在所评价的超声波和核磁共振数据集中获得准确的登记。 BNN提供了预测变形场的分布,对估计空间不确定性有用. 推而论之,其节节关. 贝叶斯地层的参数化使用了以前的标准偏差 \ 1 = 1.0\sigma_{1}=1.0和\ 2 = 0.002\sigma_{2}=0.02, 混合系数 → = 0.5\pi=0.5, 后期表示μ = 0\mu=0, 后期参数 → → 3.0\rho=-3.0.

blocks.en: The uncertainty model should be quick, ideally with a cost comparable or lower to that or the registration itself, and only use the image pair rather than the deformation field. Since our method is iterative, we require an uncertainty estimate that can be recomputed at each refinement step. For these reasons, we chose to use a lightweight U-Net network to approximate the empirical uncertainty. The network consists of 2 layers and 465,138 parameters.
blocks.zh: 不确定性模型应当迅速,最好是成本与成本相当或低于成本或登记本身,只使用图像对而不是变形场。 由于我们的方法是迭代的,我们需要一个不确定的估计,在每个改进步骤中都可以重算出来。 由于这些原因,我们选择使用一个轻量级的U-Net网络来估计经验上的不确定性. 网络由2层和465,138个参数组成.

blocks.en: The residual error can be calculated using a range of similarity measures. We chose the local normalised cross-correlation for its robustness across imaging modalities and its insensitivity to global intensity differences. To increase the dynamic range of the sampling map and amplify the contrast between high- and low-error regions, an exponential transformation is applied to the residual map prior to normalisation.
blocks.zh: 剩余误差可以使用一系列相似度量法计算. 我们选择了当地常态化的交叉关系,因为它在成像方式上具有强性,对全球强度差异不敏感。 为了增加采样图的动态范围,扩大高热区和低热区之间的对比,在正常化前对剩余图进行了指数转换.

blocks.en: We evaluated our selective gating algorithm on two datasets. First, the Automatic Cardiac Diagnosis Challenge (ACDC) dataset, which contains cardiac magnetic resonance acquisitions from 1.5T and 3.0T MRIs [ 17 ] . The total training dataset has 100 patients with two volumes per patient, and 560 training image pairs. We extracted axial cardiac images to perform this analysis in two-dimensional images. Cardiac Acquisitions for Multi-structure Ultrasound Segmentation (CAMUS) is an ultrasound dataset containing cardiac acquisitions from 450 healthy and anomalous patients in multiple views [ 18 ] . Each acquisition was segmented by a clinical expert, providing ground truth anatomical information. 4500 images were used for training. We used each patient as an independent sample. Train:test:validation splits were performed by dividing across patients so no patient was in both.
blocks.zh: 我们在两个数据集上评估了我们的选择性测距算法。 首先,自动心跳诊断挑战(ACDC)数据集包含从1.5T和3.0T MRIs获得的心脏磁共振[17]. 总培训数据集有100名患者,每名患者有2卷,560名培训图像对. 我们提取了轴心影像 以二维图像进行这种分析 多结构超声波分片(CAMUS)的心电图获取器是一个超声波数据集,包含450名健康异常患者在多种观点中的心电图获取[18]. 每次收购均由临床专家分解,提供地面真相解剖信息. 培训中使用了4500个图像。 我们用每个病人作为独立样本 列车:测试:通过在病人之间进行划分来进行验证分裂,所以没有病人在两者之中.

blocks.en: 3.4 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 3.4 读取研究

blocks.en: An ablation study was performed to determine which components of the proposed algorithm are responsible for the improvement in registration accuracy. The full method using both uncertainty-based and error-based gating was compared to three ablations. • A1 no gating. The iterative multistep registration is applied without any spatial gating or modulation. The full predicted update is applied at each iteration. This ablation tests for improvements due to the iterative registration itself. • A2 random gating. The gating map is replaced with a random gating map, which is then smoothed and normalized. This ablation tests for the improvements due to spatially varying gating. • A3 intensity-based gating. The moving image is smoothed with a gaussian blur and normalized to yield the gating map. This ablation tests whether a simpler image-based structural prior is sufficient to guide refinement.
blocks.zh: 开展了一项减征研究,以确定拟议算法的哪些组成部分负责提高登记准确性。 将使用基于不确定性和基于误差的标注法的全方法比作三个拼写法. • A1号禁食。 迭代多步骤注册在应用时没有任何空间定位或调制. 每个迭代都应用了完整的预测更新. 由于迭代登记本身,这一改进测试。 • A2 随机标注。  g图换成随机的 g图,然后平滑,正常化. 由于空间变化的标点,这种改进的减速测试。 • 基于A3强度的鳄鱼。 移动的图像被加乌西模糊而平滑,并正常化以产生吉卜赛图. 这种偏差测试一个更简单的基于图像的结构前置是否足以指导完善.

blocks.en: 3.5 Application to pretrained models
blocks.zh: 3.5 对预训型号的应用

blocks.en: An important advantage of the proposed error-based gating strategy is that it can be applied entirely at inference time, without modifying the original training procedure. This allows the method to be used as a plug-in iterative refinement framework for existing pretrained registration models.
blocks.zh: 拟议的基于误差的测量策略的一个重要优点是,它可以在推断时间完全应用,而不修改原来的训练程序. 这使得该方法可以用作现有预训登记模型的插件迭代完善框架.

blocks.en: To validate this, we applied the method to several publicly available pretrained models, namely TransMorph, VoxelMorph, CycleMorph, with pretrained weights extracted from [ 19 ] . These models were trained on the IXI dataset, a 3-D brain MRI registration dataset [ 20 ] . For each model, we compared the original one-step inference result with the output obtained when the same model was used within our iterative error-based gating framework.
blocks.zh: 为了验证这一点,我们把这种方法应用于几种公开的预训模型,即TransMorph,VoxelMorph,CycleMorph,其中预训重量取自[19]. 这些模型接受了九一数据集的培训,一个三维脑磁共振登记数据集[20]. 对于每个模型,我们比较了最初的单步推论结果与当在我们基于迭代错误的引子框架内使用同一模型时获得的输出.

blocks.en: This experiment was designed to assess whether the proposed method can improve registration accuracy without retraining, and whether these gains generalize across different network architectures. All pretrained-model experiments were evaluated using the same metrics as in the main experiments.
blocks.zh: 这项实验旨在评估拟议方法能否提高登记准确性而不进行再培训,以及这些收益是否贯穿于不同的网络结构。 所有训练有素的模型实验都采用与主要实验相同的度量标准进行评估。

blocks.en: 3.6 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.6 评价

blocks.en: Registration performance was evaluated on two held-out test cohorts, of 50 patients on ACDC and 100 patients on CAMUS, with splits dividing by patient so no patient is in both the training and test cohorts. Unless otherwise stated, the experiments were performed using a fixed random seed.

All statistical analyses were carried out at the patient level. Where multiple measurements were available for a patient, they were aggregated before statistical testing. Pairwise comparisons between baselines and RUGI were performed using two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank tests. blocks.en: 3.7 Validation of Estimated Uncertainty
blocks.zh: 3.7 估计不确定性的审定

blocks.en: To assess whether the uncertainty predicted by our additional network identifies regions with residual registration error, registration was compared spatially with the absolute error | I f ​ i ​ x ​ e ​ d − I w ​ a ​ r ​ p ​ e ​ d | |I_{fixed}-I_{warped}| . In the ultrasound datasets, this error map was lightly smoothed to decrease the influence of speckle intensity variations. Pixels with negligible intensity in both fixed and warped images were excluded.

blocks.en: For each image, valid pixels were ranked independently by predicted uncertainty and residual error. The top 20% of pixels for each measure were identified. Spatial overlap was calculated as the proportion of the top-20% uncertainty pixels that were also present in the top-20% residual error. As both masks contain 20% of the valid pixels, the expected overlap under random spatial correspondence is 20%. Spatial enrichment was calculated as the observed overlap divided by 0.20, such that a value of 1 corresponds to the expected overlap due to chance.

blocks.en: To account for small spatial offsets between uncertainty and residual-error regions, we calculated tolerance-aware overlap. For a tolerance of r r pixels, each binary top-20% mask was dilated using a square neighbourhood extending r r pixels in each direction. The proportion of uncertainty-mask pixels falling within this neighbourhood was calculated, together with the reciprocal proportion of residual-error pixels falling within that region. The mean of these two values was reported as the tolerance-aware overlap. Tolerance values r r of 1, 2, 3 and 5 pixels were evaluated.

blocks.zh: 重要的是,减速的标点战略改善了图像与单步注册的相似性。 这表明变形场的迭代完善即使没有选择性的标点也是有益的. 然而,单是这种反复重复并不能充分解释RUGI的表现. 随机和基于强度的标注的低性能也表明标注必须包含剩余登记错误的相关信息.

blocks.en: Taken together, the ablation results demonstrate two mechanisms by which our proposed framework improves performance. Recursive optimisation of the deformation fields provides an improvement over single-step inference, while selective gating provides a significant additional improvement. Both uncertainty and error estimation provide informative spatial gating, while uninformed schedules consistently and significantly underperform regardless of dataset or metric.
blocks.zh: 综合起来,减幅结果表明,我们拟议框架通过两个机制改进了业绩。 变形场的递归优化提供了比单步推论的改进,而选择性的引纹则提供了显著的额外改进. 不确定性和误差估计都提供了信息化的空间定位,而不管数据集或衡量标准如何,不知情的时间表都一贯和明显地表现不佳。

blocks.en: 4.2.1 Validation of Estimated Uncertainty
blocks.zh: 4.2.1 估计不确定性的审定

blocks.en: Figure 9 shows example outputs for our proposed methods, as well as their uncertainty maps. For RUGI-Unc, the uncertainty map represents the predicted epistemic uncertainty of the registration model. For RUGI-Err, the displayed map represents the post-hoc variability of incremental deformation estimates across refinement iterations. RUGI-Unc generally produces smoother maps, with elevated values concentrated around myocardial structures and tissue boundaries, whereas RUGI-Err produces finer-scale spatial structure that is less exclusively localised to these boundaries.
blocks.zh: 图9显示了我们拟议方法的范例产出及其不确定性图。 对于RUGI-Unc,不确定性图代表了注册模型的预测的认知不确定性. 对于RUGI-Err,所显示的地图代表了整个精细迭代的增量变形估计的热后变异性. RUGI-Unc一般产生较平滑的地图,高值集中在心肌结构和组织边界周围,而RUGI-Err则产生较细的尺度空间结构,不完全适合这些边界。

blocks.en: To assess whether the epistemic uncertainty predicted by the RUGI-Unc model corresponded to regions of high registration error, we compared the highest-uncertainty and highest-error regions within each image. Substantial spatial correspondence was found in both datasets. Median exact overlap between the top 20% most uncertain pixels and top 20% highest-error pixels was 51.1% for ACDC and 60.7% for CAMUS, compared with an expected overlap of 20% under random spatial correspondence. This corresponds to spatial enrichments of 2.55-, 3.03-fold above chance, respectively. Exact overlap was significantly greater than chance for both datasets after Benjamini-Hochberg correction.
blocks.zh: 为了评估RUGI-Unc模型预测的震级不确定性是否与登记误差高的区域相对应,我们比较了每个图像中最不确定和最不准确的区域。 两个数据集都发现了大量的空间对应。 最高20%最不确定像素和最高20%的最高热度像素之间的中位重叠是ACDC的51.1%和CAMUS的60.7%,而在随机空间对应下,预计重叠率为20%。 这与空间浓缩率分别为2.55倍、3.03倍。 在Benjamini-Hochberg修正后,准确的重叠大大超过两个数据集的机会。

blocks.en: We additionally assessed overlap while allowing for small spatial offsets at the boundaries of the masks. Overlap increased consistently with increasing spatial tolerance across all datasets. At a tolerance of 1 pixel, median overlap increased to 69.1% for ACDC, 76.0% for CAMUS. At 3 pixels, overlap reached 79.7% and 88.5%, respectively. The rapid increase in overlap with relatively small spatial tolerances indicates that a substantial component of the incomplete exact pixelwise overlap arose from slightly displaced uncertainty and residual-error regions.
blocks.zh: 我们还评估了重叠情况,同时允许在口罩的边界上进行小空间抵消。 随着所有数据集空间容忍度的提高,重叠现象不断增加。 在1像素的耐受度下,中位重叠率在催化分解中心增至69.1%,在CAMUS为76.0%. 在3像素时,重叠率分别达到79.7%和88.5%。 与空间容忍度相对较小的重叠迅速增加,表明不完全的精确像素重叠的很大一部分来自略微转移的不确定性和残留偏差区域。

blocks.en: Both RUGI variants achieved statistically significant improvements in EF estimation over the BNN baseline across both datasets. All methods systematically underestimate EF, as the more common failure mode is to not capture the full transformation. In ACDC, RUGI-Unc reduced EF MAE from 27.5% to 14.9%, a 45.8% relative reduction, while RUGI-Err achieved 16.0% MAE (Cohen’s d = 1.418 d=1.418 and 1.535 1.535 respectively, p < 0.001 p<0.001 ). Similar improvements were observed in CAMUS, where RUGI-Unc and RUGI-Err reduced MAE from 30.9% to 23.0% and 25.2% respectively (Cohen’s d = 2.047 d=2.047 for RUGI-Unc and d = 1.522 d=1.522 for RUGI-Err). All pairwise comparisons against the BNN baseline were statistically significant ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 , Wilcoxon signed-rank test), with effect sizes consistently in the large range ( d > 0.8 d>0.8 ). Figure 10 shows the predicted and ground-truth EF for all three methods. The slope of linear regression for the baseline BNN is shallow in both datasets (ACDC: s ​ l ​ o ​ p ​ e = 0.45 slope=0.45 , CAMUS: s ​ l ​ o ​ p ​ e = 0.12 slope=0.12 ), showing the baseline model consistently underestimates the ejection fraction and it fails to capture the variance across patients. Both proposed RUGI methods achieve regression slopes closest to the identity line, with higher slopes and R 2 R^{2} values (ACDC: s ​ l ​ o ​ p ​ e = 0.70 slope=0.70 / 0.66 0.66 , CAMUS: s ​ l ​ o ​ p ​ e = 0.89 slope=0.89 / 0.86 0.86 , for RUGI-Unc and RUGI-Err respectively). This shows RUGI recovers not only a lower absolute error but it also captures inter-patient variation in cardiac function. Importantly, because RUGI produces per-pixel uncertainty estimates, EF predictions can be accompanied by uncertainty intervals, which enable interpretation of the clinical parameters.

blocks.en: The Jacobian determinant ( J ¯ ) (\bar{J}) shows the degree of expansion and compression in the deformation field. All methods produce values close to unity across all datasets, meaning the deformations are area-preserving. RUGI variants exhibit marginally larger deviations from unity than the BNN baseline, which is expected given that iterative refinement accumulates small perturbations over multiple steps. Importantly, the percentage of voxels with negative Jacobian determinant, indicating physically impossible folding, remains below 2% for all methods and datasets, indicating that the rate of folding remained low despite iterative refinement.

blocks.en: These results demonstrate that RUGI improves not only registration accuracy, as measured by EF and DSC, but also the clinical utility of the output by providing per-sample uncertainty quantification. The availability of uncertainty intervals on EF and field regularity metrics represents a qualitative advance over deterministic registration methods: rather than producing a single point estimate with no indication of reliability, RUGI provides information for downstream algorithms to reason about the trustworthiness of each individual measurement.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,RUGI不仅通过EF和DSC测量提高了注册精度,而且通过提供每个样本的不确定性量化,提高了产出的临床效用. EF和外地常态度测量值的不确定性间隔的可得性比确定性登记方法在质量上有所改进:RUGI不是在不表明可靠性的情况下提供单一点估计值,而是为下游算法提供信息,说明每项计量值的可信赖性。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: Learning-based registration models are quick at inference-time, but they generally estimate the full deformation in a single forward pass and have no ability to adapt. We introduced RUGI, a framework to iteratively refine predicted deformations while modulating each update. Across cardiac MRI and echocardiography, both uncertainty- and error-gated variants consistently improved registration performance relative to single-step inference. By weighting the incremental update by the normalised uncertainty maps, RUGI concentrates refinement effort where the initial single-step prediction is least reliable, while suppressing potentially destabilizing updates in already well-registered regions. This allows RUGI to correct the residual misalignment that single-step inference obtains.
blocks.zh: 基于学习的注册模式在推论时很快,但它们一般在一次前传中估计完全变形,没有适应能力. 我们引入了RUGI,这个框架可以迭代地完善预测的变形,同时调制每个更新. 在整个心脏核磁共振和回声心电图中,不确定性和误差的变体都比单步推论不断提高登记性能。 通过将增量更新与常态化的不确定性图进行加权,RUGI将精细化工作集中在最初的单步预测最不可靠的地方,同时在已经登记良好的地区抑制可能破坏稳定的更新。 这使得RUGI能够纠正单步推论所获得的剩余错位.

blocks.en: RUGI methods produced statistically significant improvements over single-step inference across an MRI and an ultrasound dataset according to all four image similarity metrics. Improvements across both studied datasets show RUGI is not restricted to a single modality, but captures a general weakness of single-step feed-forward registration: the inability to correct residual misalignment after a single forward pass. This improvement in performance is maintained when applying our error-based gating strategy to iterate on pre-trained models.
blocks.zh: RUGI方法在统计学上比磁共振的单步推论和超声波数据集根据所有四个图像相似度度度测量得出了显著的改进。 跨越两个研究数据集的改进显示RUGI并不局限于一种单一模式,而是捕捉单步进气前行登记的一个普遍弱点:在一次前行后无法纠正剩余错配. 在运用基于错误的测距策略在预先训练的模型上进行测距时,业绩的这种改进得到了维持。

blocks.en: The ablation study isolates the gating signal as a critical component driving performance gains. Replacing the learnt signal with a random map (A2) consistently produced the largest degradation, but all ablations performed worse than both the uncertainty-based and error-based methods. However, it is worth noting that even the weakest ablations, the no-gating (A1) and intensity-based (A3), still improved over the single-step baseline, demonstrating that iterative refinement itself provides a benefit independent of the gating strategy. This suggests the contributions of our method are two-fold: the iterative mechanism provides a baseline improvement, and the selective gating function further improves the registration accuracy.
blocks.zh: 消化研究将 g信号隔离为驱动性能增益的关键组成部分. 用随机地图(A2)取代所学到的信号,始终产生最大的降解,但所有降解都比基于不确定性和基于错误的方法更糟糕。 然而,值得指出的是,即使是最薄弱的炮火,即无枪炮(A1)和强度炮火(A3),仍然比单步基线有所改进,这表明迭接改进本身提供了独立于枪炮战略的好处。 这表明我们的方法的贡献有两重:迭代机制提供了基线改进,选择性的钓鱼功能进一步提高了注册的准确性.

blocks.en: The two proposed gating strategies performed similarly overall, with neither consistently dominating according to image similarity. The uncertainty-based method is consistently better in ejection fraction estimation, but with only two datasets conclusions cannot be drawn. The uncertainty-based method requires an additional trained network but provides a gating signal specific to the registration model. The error-based method is simpler and model-agnostic, enabling its application to pretrained models. The latter is desirable when retraining is unavailable.
blocks.zh: 这两项拟议的配乐战略在整体上表现类似,但从图像的相似性来看,两者并不一致。 基于不确定性的方法在弹射分数估计方面一直比较好,但只有两个数据集无法得出结论. 基于不确定性的方法需要额外的训练有素的网络,但提供与登记模式具体相关的信号。 基于错误的方法比较简单,模型不可知,使其应用到预先训练的模型上. 在没有再培训的情况下,后者是可取的。

blocks.en: Several limitations should be noted. First, the uncertainty-based RUGI requires supervised training using samples from the registration model, which adds complexity to the training pipeline and ties the uncertainty estimates to the quality of the base model. Error-based RUGI avoids this requirement but is more dependent on the image residual providing an informative signal. Second, the iterative inference increases computational cost relative to a single forward pass, which may be prohibitive in real-time applications. Third, our experiments used 2D registration; the extension to 3D (demonstrated only for the pretrained model experiments) may introduce additional computational constraints. Fourth, performance was not uniform across all architecture-metric combinations, as demonstrated in SSIM for CycleMorph. The stopping criterion is based on image similarity improvement, which may not always align with anatomical registration accuracy; incorporating landmark-based or segmentation-based stopping criteria could improve reliability in settings where ground truth deformation is partially available.
blocks.zh: 应当指出若干限制。 首先,基于不确定性的RUGI需要使用登记模型的样本进行监督培训,这增加了培训管道的复杂性,并将不确定性估计与基准模型的质量联系在一起。 基于错误的RUGI避免了这一要求,但更依赖于图像残存提供信息信号. 第二,迭代推论比单次前传增加了计算成本,这在实时应用中可能令人望而却步. 第三,我们的实验使用2D注册;扩展到3D(仅用于预先训练过的模型实验)可能会引入额外的计算限制. 第四,所有建筑计量组合的性能并不统一,如循环莫尔夫的SSIM所示. 停止标准基于图像相似性改进,这种改进可能并不总是与解剖登记准确性相一致;纳入基于地标的或基于分解的停止标准,可以在部分存在地面真假变形的环境下提高可靠性。

blocks.en: The larger improvements observed in ACDC relative to CAMUS highlight an important limitation of the current method. Ultrasound registration is generally more challenging because of lower signal-to-noise ratio, spatially varying speckle and intensity, and out-of-plane motion that can make local correspondences ambiguous. Although RUGI still improved upon the single-step baseline, the smaller gains suggest the current strategy is less effective under these conditions. Further improvements could improve correspondence estimation in difficult regions, for example multi-scale or pyramidal refinement, further regularisation of the loss at inference, or the incorporation of structural priors such as anatomical landmarks.
blocks.zh: 非洲疾病防治中心相对于CAMUS观察到的较大改进突出了目前方法的一个重要局限性。 超声波的注册通常更具挑战性,因为信号与噪声的比例较低,空间上不同的光谱和强度,以及飞机外运动可以使本地通信变得模糊不清. 虽然区域治理倡议在单步骤基线上仍有改进,但较小的收获表明,在这些条件下,现行战略不太有效。 进一步的改进可以改善困难地区的函证估计,例如多尺度或金字塔式的改进,进一步规范推断损失,或纳入结构前科,如解剖地标。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We proposed RUGI, an algorithm for uncertainty-gated deformation field refinement at inference-time. By focusing updates on regions of the images with high uncertainty, our method is able to adapt to spatially heterogeneous difficulty. The resulting uncertainty maps provide spatially interpretable uncertainty estimates that identify spatial variation in registration reliability and can be propagated to downstream tasks. Statistically significant improvements were demonstrated across cardiac MRI and ultrasound datasets, with improvements in intensity-based metrics and anatomical alignment. The framework generalises to existing pretrained architectures without retraining, yielding MSE reductions of 27–37% across VoxelMorph, TransMorph, and CycleMorph. The improvement in estimation of diagnostic parameters demonstrates that these differences in performance can be meaningful for downstream functional parameter estimation. This work demonstrates the value of uncertainty estimation not only to improve interpretability but also to drive performance in medical imaging tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了RUGI,一种在推论时间进行不确定性定型变形场改进的算法. 通过将图像的更新集中在具有高度不确定性的区域,我们的方法能够适应各种空间难度。 由此产生的不确定性图提供了可空间解释的不确定性估计,可识别登记可靠性的空间差异,并可推广到下游任务中。 从统计学上看,在心脏核磁共振和超声波数据集方面取得了显著的改进,在强度测量和解剖一致性方面有所改进。 框架概括了现有的未再培训的前期建筑,使得VoxelMorph、TransMorph和CycleMorph的MSE减少27-37%。 诊断参数估计的改进表明,这些性能差异对下游功能参数估计可能有意义。 这项工作表明,不确定性估计的价值不仅在于提高可解释性,而且在于推动医疗成像任务的业绩。
